segments.source_text: The Government of Ethiopia believes that family planning is one of the key strategies to improving maternal health and bringing about overall socio-economic development to the country.
segments.translated_text: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ የእናቶች ጤና ለማሻሻል እና አጠቃላይ ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ እድገትን ለሀገሪቱ ለማምጣት አንዱ ቁልፍ ስትራቴጂ ነው ብሎ ያምናል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00007
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: This commitment is in line with the health policy which clearly indicates that the health and wellbeing of the society shall be kept through providing and regulating the highest possible quality of a comprehensive package of health services in an equitable manner. This had been proved by the successful integration of FP services to HIV/AIDS care and treatment and the health extension service package.
segments.translated_text: ይህ ቁርጠኝነት ከጤና ፖሊሲው ጋር የተጣጣመ ሲሆን የህብረተሰቡን ጤና እና ደህንነት መጠበቅ የሚቻለውን ሁሉን አቀፍ የጤና አገልግሎት ፓኬጅ ፍትሃዊ በሆነ መንገድ በማቅረብና በመቆጣጠር ነው። ይህ በተሳካ ውህደት የኤፍፒ አገልግሎቶች ለኤች.አይ.ቪ/ኤድስ እንክብካቤ እና ሕክምና እና በጤና ኤክስቴንሽን አገልግሎት ፓኬጅ ተረጋግጧል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00008
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: As a result; the Contraceptive prevalence rate (CPR) has steadily increased to 41% and unmet need has declined to 22% in the past two decades. The FP service uptake has also showed a nation-wide increase due to the integration of the FP service with HIV/AIDS and HEP in the country.
segments.translated_text: በውጤቱም; የየእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀም መጠን (CPR) ያለማቋረጥ ወደ 41 በመቶ አድጓል እና ያልተሟላ ፍላጎት ባለፉት ሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ወደ 22 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል። የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ቅበላ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ውህደት ከኤች.አይ.ቪ/ኤድስ እና HEP ጋር በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ እድገት አሳይቷል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00009
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: MoH is also committed to improve the maternal and child health outcomes through attaining the HSTP II, and the SDG goals and targets using FP as one of the key strategies. Moreover; MoH considers that access to FP service is among the reproductive health rights of a woman and it is one of the tools to prevent unintended pregnancy and reduce maternal mortality and morbidity.
segments.translated_text: MoH በተጨማሪም የእናቶች እና የደብሊውሲኤምቲ0002 ውጤቶችን ለማሻሻል HSTP IIን፣ እና የኤስዲጂ ግቦችን እና ግቦችን FPን እንደ ቁልፍ ስትራቴጂዎች በመጠቀም ለማሻሻል ቁርጠኛ ነው። ከዚህም በላይ; MoH የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ማግኘት ከ የመራባት ጤና የሴት መብቶች መካከል አንዱ እንደሆነ እና ያልታሰበ እርግዝናን ለመከላከል እና የእናቶች ሞት እና ህመምን ለመቀነስ ከሚረዱ መሳሪያዎች ውስጥ አንዱ እንደሆነ ይመለከታል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00010
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Additionally, the 2021-2025 National RH strategic plan highlighted that provision of quality FP service to every woman, newborn, adolescent and youth requires effective service integration across the RMNCH-N spectrum.
segments.translated_text: በተጨማሪም፣ የ2021-2025 ብሄራዊ RH ስትራቴጂክ እቅድ ጥራት ያለው የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት አቅርቦት ለእያንዳንዱ ሴት፣ አዲስ ልደት፣ ጎረምሳ እና ወጣት በRMNCH-N ስፔክትረም ውጤታማ አገልግሎት ውህደት እንደሚያስፈልግ አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00011
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Hence; this guideline, the first of its kind to outline implementation issues encompassing FP service integration; is intended to provide guidance to initiate, support and sustain FP program through RH and non-RH service outlets including in HIV/ART, PMTCT, ANC, Labor and delivery, PNC, EPI < 5 child health care and adult OPD. It also outlines the importance of linkage of clients coming to FP services to other RH
segments.translated_text: ስለዚህም; ይህ መመሪያ የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ውህደትን የሚያጠቃልለውን የትግበራ ጉዳዮችን ለመዘርዘር በአይነቱ የመጀመሪያው ነው። በHIV/ART፣ ከእናት ወደ ልጅ የሚተላለፍ ኤች.አይ.ቪ ስርጭት መከላከል፣ ANC፣ ምጥና ወሊድ፣ PNC፣ EPI < 5 የህጻናት ጤና00 እንክብካቤ እና አዋቂ WC1 ጨምሮ RH እና RH ላልሆኑ የአገልግሎት ማሰራጫዎች የFP ፕሮግራምን ለማስጀመር፣ ለመደገፍ እና ለማስቀጠል የታሰበ ነው። እንዲሁም ወደ FP አገልግሎቶች የሚመጡ ደንበኞች ከሌሎች አርኤች ጋር ያለውን ትስስር አስፈላጊነት ይገልፃል።

segments.source_text: The development of the National FP service integration implementation guideline is the product of repeated consultative meetings held among a wide cross-section of partners and stakeholders organized and led by the FP case team and MCHN directorate of the Ministry of Health.
segments.translated_text: የብሔራዊ የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ውህደት የትግበራ መመሪያን ማዘጋጀት በኤፍፒ ኬዝ ቲም እና በደብሊውሲኤምቲ0003 MCHN ዳይሬክቶሬት የተደራጁ እና የሚመሩ ሰፊ አጋሮች እና ባለድርሻ አካላት መካከል የተካሄዱ ተደጋጋሚ የምክክር ስብሰባዎች ውጤት ነው።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00157
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: The MoH, MCHN directorate would like to acknowledge all stakeholders in general and EngenderHealth Ethiopia in particular; for their technical and financial support provided for the development of this FP service Integration National guideline.
segments.translated_text: የMoH፣ MCHN ዳይሬክቶሬት ሁሉንም ባለድርሻ አካላት ባጠቃላይ እና በተለይ EngenderHealth ኢትዮጵያ እውቅና መስጠት ይፈልጋል። ለዚህ የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ውህደት ብሄራዊ መመሪያ ለማዘጋጀት ለነበራቸው የቴክኒክ እና የገንዘብ ድጋፍ።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00158
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Moreover, the Ministry is grateful and appreciate the comments, inputs and suggestions forwarded by individuals who had worked tirelessly to make this guideline a reality
segments.translated_text: በተጨማሪም ሚኒስቴሩ ይህንን መመሪያ እውን ለማድረግ በግለሰቦች የቀረቡትን አስተያየቶች፣ ግብዓቶች እና አስተያየቶች አድንቋል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00159
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Service integration has been defined in many different ways; however, the Cochrane Group has defined it as – “A variety of managerial or operational changes to health systems to bring together inputs, delivery, management and organization of particular service functions”.
segments.translated_text: አገልግሎት ውህደት በተለያዩ መንገዶች ተገልጿል; ይሁን እንጂ የኮክራን ቡድን ይህንን ገልጾታል - "በጤና ስርዓቶች ላይ የሚደረጉ የተለያዩ የአመራር ወይም የአሠራር ለውጦች ግብአቶችን, አቅርቦትን, አስተዳደርን እና የተወሰኑ የአገልግሎት ተግባራትን አደረጃጀት" በማለት ገልፀዋል.

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00160
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: It aims at “improving the service in relation to efficiency and quality, thereby maximizing use of resources and opportunities” (Briggs & Garner, 2009).
segments.translated_text: ዓላማው "ከብቃትና ጥራት ጋር በተገናኘ አገልግሎቱን ለማሻሻል፣ በዚህም የሀብቶችን እና እድሎችን አጠቃቀምን ከፍ ለማድረግ" (ብሪግስ እና ጋርነር፣ 2009)።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00161
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Family panning service integration- It refers to “an incorporation of managerial or operational changes to health system/service to bring together inputs, delivery, management and organization of family planning service with the aims of improving access, quality and efficiency thereby maximizing use of resources and opportunities”.
segments.translated_text: የቤተሰብ ፓኒንግ አገልግሎት ውህደት- “በጤና ስርዓት/አገልግሎት ላይ የሚደረጉ የአመራር ወይም የአሠራር ለውጦችን በማካተት የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ግብአት፣ አቅርቦት፣ አስተዳደር እና አደረጃጀት ተደራሽነትን፣ ጥራትን እና ቅልጥፍናን በማሻሻል የሀብቶችን እና እድሎችን አጠቃቀምን ከፍ ለማድረግ” የሚለውን ያመለክታል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00162
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Smart integration/ one stop shopping approach: refers to “Providing a comprehensive SRH services at a service area in a given facility”. Examples of one stop shopping are FP service integration in CAC and ART service.
segments.translated_text: ስማርት ውህደት/ የአንድ ማቆሚያ ግብይት አቀራረብ፡- “በአንድ ተቋም ውስጥ በአገልግሎት ቦታ ላይ አጠቃላይ የSRH አገልግሎቶችን መስጠትን” ያመለክታል። የአንድ ማቆሚያ ግብይት ምሳሌዎች የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ውህደት በCAC እና ART አገልግሎት ናቸው።

segments.source_text: In the past two decades, Ethiopia has succeeded in improving the overall maternal and child health services in general and FP/RH services in particular. Hence; the contraceptive prevalence rate (CPR) has steadily increased to 41.4 % by the year 2019 from its baseline value of 8% in 2000.
segments.translated_text: ባለፉት ሁለት አስርት አመታት ደብሊውሲኤምቲ0001 አጠቃላይ የእናቶችን እና የደብሊውሲኤምቲ0002 አገልግሎቶችን በአጠቃላይ በተለይም የFP/RH አገልግሎቶችን በማሻሻል ረገድ ተሳክቶለታል። ስለዚህም; የእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀም መጠን (CPR) በ2000 ከነበረው የ8% መነሻ ዋጋ በደብሊውሲኤምቲ0004 2019 ወደ 41.4 በመቶ አድጓል።

segments.source_text: Unmet need has also declined to 22 % in 2016 from 37% in 2000 and total fertility rate (TFR) from 5.5 in 2000 to 4.1 in 2019 (EDHS 2000, 2016 and Mini-DHS 2019). However; there still exists a huge disparity across regions and among various socio- demographic groups.
segments.translated_text: ያልተሟላ ፍላጎት በ2016 ከነበረበት 37% በ2000 እና ጠቅላላ የመውለድ መጠን (TFR) ከ5.5 በ2000 ወደ 4.1 በ2019 (EDHS 2000፣ 2016 እና Mini-DHS 2019) ወደ 22 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል። ቢሆንም; አሁንም በክልሎች እና በተለያዩ ማህበረሰባዊ ቡድኖች መካከል ትልቅ ልዩነት አለ።

segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Similarly, Ethiopia has made a significant progress in decreasing maternal mortality ratio (MMR) and under- five mortality in its stride to attain MDG 4 and 5 goals. However, according to the 2017 estimate by the UN; the MMR in Ethiopia still stands at 401/100,000 live birth (LB) and under-five mortality at 67/1000 LB.
segments.translated_text: በተመሳሳይ፣ ኢትዮጵያ የእናቶች ሞት ሬሾ (MMR) እና ከአምስት ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ሞትን በመቀነስ ኤምዲጂ 4 እና 5 ግቦችን ለማሳካት በሚያደርገው ግስጋሴ ከፍተኛ እድገት አሳይቷል። ሆኖም በተባበሩት መንግስታት በ 2017 ግምት መሠረት; MMR በኢትዮጵያ አሁንም በ401/100,000 ሕያው ልደት (LB) እና ከአምስት ዓመት በታች ሞት በ67/1000 LB ላይ ይገኛል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00168
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: On the other hand, in the 2nd Health Sector Transformation Plan (HSTP-II); the Ministry of Health has put ambitious targets to attain: increasing CPR (41%) to 50%, a decrease in unmet need for FP (22 %) to 19%, a decrease in TFR (4.1) to 3.23, a decrease in teenage pregnancy (12.5 %) to 7%; to reduce MMR from 401 to 279/100, 000 LB and under five mortalities from 59 to 43/1000 LB in 2024/25.
segments.translated_text: በሌላ በኩል, በ 2 ኛው የጤና ዘርፍ ትራንስፎርሜሽን ዕቅድ (HSTP-II); የየጤና ሚኒስቴር ትልቅ ግቦችን አስቀምጧል፡ CPR (41%) ወደ 50% መጨመር፣ የያልተሟላ ፍላጎት ለFP (22%) ወደ 19% መቀነስ፣ የTFR (4.1) ወደ 3.23 ቅናሽ፣ የየጎረምሳ እርግዝና (12.5%) ወደ 7% መቀነስ። MMRን ከ401 ወደ 279/100፣ 000 LB እና ከአምስት ዓመት በታች ሟቾችን ከ59 ወደ 43/1000 LB በ2024/25 ለመቀነስ።

segments.source_text: Global evidences show that maternal mortality ratio (MMR) could be decreased by 1/3 while under five mortalities by 10% with the use of FP service (Sufedin et al, the lancet, June 2012). Hence; strategies like integration of FP services will have paramount importance in increasing FP service uptake, improving CPR coverage, addressing the unmet need for FP and ultimately contributing to reduce MMR and child mortality.
segments.translated_text: ዓለም አቀፍ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት የእናቶች ሞት ሬሾ (MMR) በ1/3 እና ከአምስት ዓመት በታች ሟቾች በ 10% የቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት (Sufedin et al, the lancet, June 2012) በመጠቀም ሊቀንስ ይችላል. ስለዚህም; እንደ ውህደት ያሉ የ FP አገልግሎቶች የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት ቅበላን ለመጨመር፣የሲፒአር ሽፋንን ለማሻሻል፣የያልተሟላ ፍላጎትን ለFP ምላሽ ለመስጠት እና በመጨረሻም የMMR እና የህጻናትን ሞት ለመቀነስ አስተዋፅዖ ያደርጋሉ።

segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: The National health policy of Ethiopia; hence, states the need of providing a comprehensive package of health services; and it recognizes reproductive health (RH) and equitable access to service as essential strategies to do so.
segments.translated_text: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ የጤና ፖሊሲ; ስለሆነም አጠቃላይ የጤና አገልግሎት ፓኬጅ ማቅረብ እንደሚያስፈልግ ይገልጻል። እና የመራባት ጤና (RH) እና ፍትሃዊ የአገልግሎት ተደራሽነትን ለማድረግ እንደ አስፈላጊ ስልቶች ይገነዘባል።

segments.source_text: Furthermore, the Government of Ethiopia considers access to FP service as women’s reproductive rights and as one of the interventions of preventing unintended pregnancy to reduce maternal and child mortality.

segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Consequently, MoH is committed to attain the 2nd Health sector transformation plan (HSTP -II) and the sustainable development Goals (SDG) targets, to improve maternal and child health and bring about socioeconomic development of the country using Family planning services as one of the key strategies.
segments.translated_text: በመሆኑም ደብሊውሲኤምቲ0001 2ኛውን የደብሊውሲኤምቲ0002 (HSTP -II) እና የዘላቂ ልማት ግቦችን ለማሳካት፣ የእናቶችን እና ደብሊውሲኤምቲ0003ን ለማሻሻል እና የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎቶችን እንደ ቁልፍ ስትራቴጂዎች በመጠቀም የሀገሪቱን ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ እድገት ለማምጣት ቁርጠኛ ነው።

segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: The ministry has shown this commitment through exerting a concerted effort with the partners and stakeholders in expanding access to quality and equitable FP services across the country.

segments.source_text: Moreover, the national RH strategic plan document (2021-2025) recognizes integrated service delivery as a key strategy to provide every woman, newborn, adolescent and youth access with good-quality care. segments.source_text: The concept of Service Integration is not a new undertaking for the Ethiopian health care system. It was initiated more than two decades ago while FP service was integrated with HEP and HIV/AIDS care and treatment services.

segments.source_text: For example, managers of facilities offering RMNCAH-N or HIV care and treatment services could determine that it is feasible for their health care providers to incorporate FP counselling into their discussions with clients. segments.translated_text: * ደረጃዎች 1 እና 2 የሚለዋወጡት በባለድርሻ አካላት የ ውህደት ደረጃ ፍላጎት እና ትስስር ላይ በመመስረት ነው። ** የውህደት ደረጃዎችን እና ትስስርን ለመደገፍ የባለድርሻ አካላትን ወደ ሰራተኛ ተግባራት እና የስርዓት ተግባራትን ያካትቱ

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00298
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Linkage is an important activity in prevention of STIs, including HIV/AIDS, and reproductive organ cancers (ROC) in FP settings. Visits at FP clinics (be it integrated or not) offer clients an opportunity for detection and management of RTIs/STIs, and provide a mechanism for early detection and referral for management of cancers of the reproductive organs.
segments.translated_text: ትስስር በመከላከል STIs ውስጥ ኤች.አይ.ቪ/ኤድስ እና የመራቢያ አካላት ካንሰርን (ROC)ን ጨምሮ በFP መቼቶች ውስጥ ጠቃሚ ተግባር ነው። በኤፍፒ ክሊኒኮች (የተቀናጀም ባይሆንም) ጉብኝቶች ለደንበኞች የ RTI/STIsን የመለየት እና የማስተዳደር እድልን ይሰጣሉ፣ እና ቀደም ብሎ ለመለየት እና ሪፈራል የመራቢያ አካላትን ካንሰር ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ዘዴን ይሰጣል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00299
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: Ø FP service providers are expected to link clients to get other RH services like reproductive Organ Cancer (ROC) screening, PICT, STI prevention and care etc. as required by adopting the following practices.
segments.translated_text: Ø የየቤተሰብ ምጣኔ አገልግሎት አገልግሎት አቅራቢዎች የሚከተሉትን ልምዶች በመከተል እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ሌሎች እንደ ተዋልዶ የአካል ካንሰር (ROC) ምርመራ ማድረግ፣ PICT፣ STI መከላከል እና እንክብካቤ ወዘተ የመሳሰሉ የRH አገልግሎቶችን እንዲያገኙ ደንበኞችን ማገናኘት ይጠበቅባቸዋል።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00300
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: § Provide clients with information on high-risk sexual behavior; risks of contracting STIs and HIV/AIDS and their mode of transmission.
segments.translated_text: § ከፍተኛ ስጋት ስላለበት የግብረ ሥጋ ባህሪ መረጃ ለደንበኞች መስጠት፤ STIs እና ኤች.አይ.ቪ/ኤድስ እና የእነሱ የስርጭት የመግባት አደጋዎች።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00301
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: § Educate clients on common reproductive cancers and the importance of early detection and treatment of premalignant lesions.
segments.translated_text: § ደንበኞችን ስለ የተለመዱ የመራቢያ ካንሰሮች እና ቀደም ብሎ የማወቅ አስፈላጊነት እና ሕክምና ቀደም ሲል የሚከሰቱ ጉዳቶችን ያስተምሩ።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00302
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: § Screen clients for cervical cancer using visual inspection and acetic acid (VIA).
segments.translated_text: የእይታ ምርመራ እና አሴቲክ አሲድ (VIA) በመጠቀም ለየማኅጸን ጫፍ ካንሰር የስክሪን ደንበኞች።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00303
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: § Promote the use of condoms (male and female) for clients who are at risk of acquiring STIs, even if they are using other methods of FP (see dual protection, above).
segments.translated_text: § ኮንዶሞች (ወንድ እና ሴት) ለደንበኞች ማስተዋወቅ who STIs የማግኘት አደጋ ላይ ናቸው፣ ምንም እንኳን ሌሎች የFP ዘዴዎችን እየተጠቀሙ ቢሆንም (ከላይ ያለውን ድርብ ጥበቃ ይመልከቱ)።

segments.segment_id: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf::s00304
segments.document_name: FAMILY PLANNING SERVICE INTEGRATION NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDELINE.pdf
segments.source_text: § Provide Health Information/educate all clients about high-risk sexual behavior – The protective benefits of male and female condoms – The need to have sexual partner(s) evaluated and treated if a client is found to have an STI – The importance of knowing one’s HIV status and information on where HTC services may be obtained.
segments.translated_text: § የጤና መረጃ ያቅርቡ/ስለ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ስላለባቸው የግብረ-ሥጋ ባህሪያት ሁሉንም ደንበኞች ያስተምሩ - የወንድ እና የሴት መከላከያ ጥቅሞች ኮንዶሞች - ደንበኛ STI እንዳለው ከተረጋገጠ የግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት ባልደረባ(ዎች) መገምገም እና መታከም አስፈላጊነት STI - የአንድን ሰው HIV የማወቅ አስፈላጊነት HIV የ HIV አገልግሎት የት ሊገኝ ይችላል ።
